subject: planner: Fix issue 52198, HandleColOffset was wrong. (#52210)
summary: Fixes PointGet on partitioned tables by setting `PointGetPlan.HandleColOffset` from the table column offset (`model.ColumnInfo.Offset`) instead of the pruned schema index, preventing wrong partition routing when earlier columns are pruned (e.g. PK not at offset 0). Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: this PointGet change remains in place with no follow-up correctness fixes needed for it.
